Århus, Denmark), better known as 
Anne Gadegaard, is a Danish singer and songwriter. She is best known for finishing 5th at the 
Junior Eurovision Song Contest 2003 while representing Denmark. 
Career[edit]2003: Junior Eurovision Song Contest 2003 and Arabiens Drøm[edit]Main articles: 
Junior Eurovision Song Contest 2003 and 
Arabiens DrømAnne started singing in 2002, inspired by the success of child singer 
Razz. In 2003, she entered the 
Danish MGP Contest 2003, where she was accepted, and later, won the competition to represent Denmark at the 
Junior Eurovision Song Contest 2003. Her song was called "Arabiens Drøm". Although it had very good reviews, it did not win the contest. The song finished 5th out of 16 participants, scoring 93 points. During that year, she released her debut studio album 
Arabiens Drøm.
